name: One Plus Airpods Pro Copy
description:
Brand: OnePlus
Model: Airpods Pro 

Battery:

Charging Box Capacity: 598 mAh (Can charge earbuds approximately 4 times)
Earbuds Battery Capacity: 55 mAh
Calling Time: Approximately 2.5 hours
Standby Time: Up to 20 hours
Long Standby Time: Up to 80 hours
Connectivity:

Bluetooth Version: 5.0 (Full upgrade for lossless transmission and faster connection)
Features:

Pop-Up Window Pairing: Automatically pairs when the charging box is opened.
Touch Technology: 1:1 size, comfortable to wear with no-button touch control.
Intelligent Noise Reduction: Enhanced noise cancellation for clearer calls.
Stereo Dual Channel: Improved stereo sound quality for a better listening experience.
Siri Calling Function: New feature for hands-free Siri interaction.
Compatibility: Works with both iOS and Android devices.
Design and Usage:

Comfortable Fit: Designed for comfort with new touch technology.
Easy Control: No physical buttons, touch control simplifies operation.

If have any manufacturing defect then 7 days replacement Gurranty (If products have found any spot or damage then not returnable)
